versions.content: Upon reception of a SYNC (or OFS) message a T ime Slave shall check the Sequence Counter of the received message per Time Domain against the configured value of CanTSynGlobalTimeSequenceCounterJumpWidth (according to [SWS_CanTSyn_00078] ), unless it is the first message  at Startup or  after a Time Base update timeout has been detected ( TIMEOUT bit set in Time Base synchronization status timeBaseStatus ).
